description: session.compact: the memory message from the observation ledger, with no model call, or a brief compiled by code where the Observer's memory cannot stand; a compaction given instructions goes to the built-in compactor; prompt.section: a standing note on compaction and how to resume; turn.start: times the main conversation's prompts and keeps its recent turn starts; turn.step: observes a long turn mid-turn; turn.complete: observes the finished turn in the background through pi; session.start: registers om_recall and om_stats and prunes sessions long untouched; store.set: prunes the oldest sessions when the store is full; tool.call: runs om_recall and om_stats; tool.describe: keeps om_recall out of the deferred tools once the session has compacted; command.run: /om-stats; classic.SessionStart and classic.Stop: record the transcript path; session.end: ends the loop's background work, and a /clear drops the session's state; skill.prompt: records the skills the session loads
